cases.name: three-record-happy-path
cases.oracle: Three RawObservation accounting rows; seq1..3; real DB applied3, client ack3, no gap; replay equal.

cases.name: duplicate-resend
cases.oracle: Deliver q1 twice with identical bytes then q2/q3; applied3 not4; identical q1 cursor; duplicate accounted.

cases.name: ack-lost-after-commit
cases.oracle: Drop server ACK after q1 committed; new authenticated session resends q1; applied1 and client ack1.

cases.name: backend-kill-after-commit-before-ack
cases.oracle: Kill owned backend at post-commit checkpoint; restart same run with fresh session/key; q1 idempotent and actual ACK survives.

cases.name: worker-abort-before-idb-commit
cases.oracle: Terminate owned writer before commit; successor reads zero rows and reusable nextSequence1.

cases.name: worker-kill-after-idb-commit
cases.oracle: Terminate after completion event; successor reads q1, nextSequence2, ack0 then resend succeeds.

cases.name: browser-restart-retained-spool
cases.oracle: Kill/restart isolated browser profile; new reader finds q1; fresh session; no context-free live continuity claim.

cases.name: replayed-frame-counter
cases.oracle: Resend authenticated frame with same counter in same session; connection rejected and no second DB apply.

cases.name: wrong-mac
cases.oracle: Mutate MAC; reject before raw journal or database write.

cases.name: wrong-origin-path
cases.oracle: Connection with wrong Origin or wrong path rejected before handshake; no records.

cases.name: secret-command-payload
cases.oracle: Inject cookie/token/raw URL/script/unknown command field; no sensitive bytes or fingerprints in any persisted logs/raw/store.

cases.name: schema-identity-mismatch
cases.oracle: Unknown schema version or wrong run/browser/stream/producer; no journal/apply/ACK.

cases.name: forward-sequence-gap
cases.oracle: Commit q1 then receive q3 without q2; retain gap evidence, close predecessor, no ACK past1; replay same rejection.

cases.name: conflicting-duplicate
cases.oracle: q1 committed then different schema-valid q1 payload/hash; conflict closes generation and does not ACK conflicting bytes.

cases.name: fake-or-regressing-ack
cases.oracle: Wrong cursor/generation or ACK beyond stored highwater rejected; local acknowledged cursor unchanged.

cases.name: raw-file-missing-or-corrupt
cases.oracle: Remove/mutate actual retained raw bytes; replay/gate fails, no loading original fixture as replacement.

cases.name: wrong-expected-state
cases.oracle: After actual execution replace parent expectation with999999; comparator fails; original observed artifact unchanged.

cases.name: capacity-bounded
cases.oracle: Use a legitimate lower configured byte cap>=1024 and<=133169152; append actual valid rows until next row exceeds that cap. Reject next append without partial sequence mutation; retain prior rows. Never fill 127MiB solely to run this test or mock IndexedDB quota.

cases.name: bounded-load-1000
cases.oracle: 1000 actual inputs; contiguous unique rows and ACK1000; correct duplicate accounting; bounded queue/storage; complete within120s or fail target explicitly.

cases.name: diagnostic-xss
cases.oracle: Escaped unsafe text and absent data shown honestly; no remote scripts/assets and no invented probabilities.

cases.name: missing-live-inputs
cases.oracle: No key/profile/review: preflight says pending; mocked sockets demonstrate zero network attempts.

cases.name: gate-tampered-or-missing-evidence
cases.oracle: Remove/alter executed artifact or duplicate caseID; gate rejects regardless of supplied PASS.

cases.name: handshake-nonce-and-reconnect
cases.oracle: Wrong nonce/direction, READY bypass or reused session/key counter reset cannot ingest; valid fresh session positivecontrol succeeds.

cases.name: journal-pending-recovery
cases.oracle: Kill after raw/receive journal durable but before outcome append; resolve from DB/idempotent apply, preserve order and do not fabricate outcome.

cases.name: source-change-invalidates-gate
cases.oracle: Change implementation/config/lock after execution; evidence is stale, gate rejects, original report retained.

cases.name: sink-rejects-forged-brand
cases.oracle: Directly forge opaque input wrapper with equal bytes but invalid raw schema; Spool refuses before write.

cases.name: partial-batch-prefix
cases.oracle: One validated BATCH q1,q2,q3. Inject a real database-write failure during q3 before its commit; q1/q2 remain committed. Send ACK2 with actual cursor plus NACK STORAGE_FAILED, never ACK3; replay records the failed attempt and committed prefix.
